title: Whitley Strieber tries to steal the craft

tellings.quote: He said, "I was going to steal it." I said, "I got like to steal this thing." And somebody started laughing behind him.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber once meant to steal a craft, so the story goes: he said, "I was going to steal it," and someone behind him started laughing. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as something Strieber told him, without saying where or when it happened. If it is true, Strieber was close enough to some craft to think about taking it.
